title: Reintroductions can backfire by destabilising food webs and triggering further extinction cascades: analysis code and simulation data
description: Code and data for the predator reintroduction study. This release brings together the Julia code for the bioenergetic food-web simulations and the R v0.4 statistical analysis, analysis-ready data, data dictionary, saved paired-bootstrap predictions and complete HTML results. The HTML report contains all eleven marginal-effect plots and the three manuscript summary figures. See the repository README for the R analysis and julia/ for the simulation code and links to the original simulation data.
